result.description: A compact indoor fountain designed for desktops, reception counters, and quiet reading corners. The Wispvale Lunara uses a ceramic basin, low-noise recirculation pump, and warm LED accent ring to create a decorative water feature with minimal maintenance. Includes a 1.2 L reservoir, USB-C power input, and three flow settings.
